detail: Two record layouts recovered for src/game/game/gamemain.c and each confirmed by a host-gcc offsetof replica compiled and RUN before adoption (the movieplayer session's method), not merely reasoned about. (1) MilestoneParam, the 0x68-stride record reached through `sMilestones` in five gamemain functions (fn_800511D0 `m`, fn_80051480 `node`, fn_80051C78 `m`, plus `m0` and `ms`): adopted from the already-recovered MilestoneParam in src/game/world/items.c lines 84-92, which walks the SAME table. Cross-TU corroboration is decisive -- items.c's own GetMilestonePos returns matrix[12], matrix[13], matrix[14] as the world position, which is exactly the `*(f32*)(m + 48/52/56)` triple gamemain read raw; and gamemain's `atan2(*(f32*)(m+32), *(f32*)(m+40))` is the matrix[8]/matrix[10] forward-vector facing extraction from the same 4x4. build/scratch/milestone_check.c asserts 11 offsets including sizeof==0x68 (equal to the stride every caller walks) and matrix[8]/[10]/[12]/[13]/[14] landing on 0x20/0x28/0x30/0x34/0x38: ALL OK, 0 mismatches. (2) FogData, the record behind world_update's `hdr = (u8*)gCurLevel + 0x70`: include/game/leveldata.h already reserves exactly `u8 fog[0x1C]` at level_data+0x70, so the record SIZE is GC-fixed independently of the Xbox PDB; the PDB's fog_data (misc.h) is exactly 0x1C with zero pad gaps and every offset gamemain reads raw (0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14/0x18) is a field start of the matching width (density/min/max/nearw/farw), with 0x00 type and 0x01 color[3] matching the byte reads hdr[0] and hdr[1..3] that build the fog colour. build/scratch/fog_check.c asserts 10 offsets including sizeof==0x1C and, critically, 0x70+offsetof(FogData,max)==0x80 -- proving the function's OTHER spelling of that same field, `*(f32*)(lv + 0x80)`, is the identical address; that site was therefore deliberately LEFT RAW under claim.law.local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges rather than unified. ALL OK, 0 mismatches. Separately, `gBossObj` was identified as a Critter*: structdraft ranked include/game/critter.h 4/4 with zero width conflicts, and gdlmem struct Critter --offset resolved all four raw offsets to GC-project-header field STARTS (0x8 state, 0xCC hitnode1, 0xAC6 unkAC6, 0xAC8 unkAC8) plus 0x4C movevec used as an address argument -- no replica needed since the header itself is the GC authority.
